recognize_zh: 臨床照片：小腿遠端內踝上方有一大片邊界不規則的潰瘍，底部為紅色肉芽組織夾雜黃色纖維蛋白，周圍皮膚大範圍暗褐色色素沉著並有乾燥脫屑，這種慢性踝周潰瘍是慢性溶血性貧血（此例為 HbH disease）的併發症。
features: Large irregular ulcer over the distal lower leg just above the medial malleolus
Ulcer base with beefy red granulation tissue and patchy yellow fibrinous slough
Slightly raised, irregular margins with a pale pink area of epithelialization at the inferior edge
Extensive surrounding dark brown hyperpigmentation with dry, scaly skin (stasis-type change)
No exposed tendon or bone and no black eschar visible
describe_en: Clinical photograph shows a large, irregular, shallow ulcer over the distal medial lower leg above the ankle. The base consists of red granulation tissue with patchy yellow fibrinous slough and a small area of re-epithelialization at the lower margin. The surrounding skin shows extensive hyperpigmentation and scaling, suggestive of chronicity. There is no visible necrotic eschar or exposed deep structures. In a patient with hemoglobin H disease, the findings are consistent with a chronic leg ulcer complicating chronic hemolytic anemia.

ddx.vs: Clinically indistinguishable malleolar ulcer, separated by hemoglobin electrophoresis showing HbS rather than HbH inclusions and microcytic indices.
Venous ulcers share the medial malleolar site and hyperpigmentation but occur with varicosities and edema without an underlying hemolytic anemia.
Pyoderma gangrenosum has undermined violaceous borders, rapid painful progression and pathergy, often with IBD or myeloid neoplasms.
Hydroxyurea ulcers occur around the malleoli during therapy and improve on drug withdrawal, requiring medication history.
